persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a silent 8-second vertical coffee clip: a close-up of coffee being poured into a ceramic cup for 5 seconds, then a plain black end card for the last 3 seconds. Center this exact URL in white: https://example.com/Go?ref=June — keep the capitals and punctuation exactly as typed, all on one line. Nothing else written anywhere.
bank.Exact URL: https://example.com/Go?ref=June — no trailing punctuation, spaces or quotation marks.
bank.End card styling: Plain black background, centered white URL on one line; font is your call.
bank.Scene and timing: Coffee pouring into a ceramic cup for the first 5 seconds, followed by the end card for the final 3 seconds.
bank.Cup and setting details: Your call, provided the cup is ceramic and the pouring is shown close up.
